name: vovk-monorepo
description: Make your Next.js app agent-ready: MCP tools, OpenAPI and typed TS/Python/Rust clients from route handlers

scripts.ncu: turbo run ncu --dangerously-disable-package-manager-check && npm run --prefix test ncu && npm-check-updates -u --cooldown 7 && npx -y npm@10 install
scripts.test:main: npm --prefix test run generate && npm --prefix test run build-other-compiled-sources && npm run lint && turbo run tsc --dangerously-disable-package-manager-check && tsc --project ./test && tsc --project ./test/tsconfig.non-strict.json && npm run test:packages && npm run unit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:main && npm run test:rs && npm run test:py && npm run test:cli
scripts.test-only: npm run build && npm --prefix test run generate && cross-env PORT=3210 concurrently "node scripts/wait-for-test-app.mjs http://localhost:3210 && NODE_ENV=test node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-only --test-concurrency=1 ./test/**/*.test.ts" "npm run serve:unit" --kill-others --success first
scripts.unit: cross-env PORT=3210 concurrently "npm run serve:unit" "node scripts/wait-for-test-app.mjs http://localhost:3210 && npm run test:unit" --kill-others --success first
scripts.unit:bun: cross-env PORT=3210 concurrently "npm run serve:unit:bun" "node scripts/wait-for-test-app.mjs http://localhost:3210 && npm run test:unit" --kill-others --success first
scripts.unit:deno: cross-env PORT=3210 concurrently "npm run serve:unit:deno" "node scripts/wait-for-test-app.mjs http://localhost:3210 && npm run test:unit" --kill-others --success first
scripts.serve:unit: npm --prefix test run generate && npm --prefix test run dev
scripts.serve:unit:bun: npm --prefix test run generate && npm --prefix test run dev:bun
scripts.serve:unit:deno: npm --prefix test run generate && npm --prefix test run dev:deno
scripts.build: npm run rm-dist --prefix packages/vovk && npm run build --prefix packages/vovk && npm run build --prefix packages/vovk-cli && turbo run build --force --dangerously-disable-package-manager-check --filter='./packages/*' && npm run link-cli

author: Andrey Gubanov
